name: Control UI 认证验证
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# Control UI 认证验证 Capsule
# 验证 Gateway Token 配置和设备配对状态

echo "🔍 检查 Gateway Token 配置..."
openclaw config get gateway.auth.token

echo ""
echo "📊 检查 Gateway 状态..."
openclaw gateway status

echo ""
echo "📱 检查设备配对状态..."
openclaw devices list

echo ""
echo "📋 查看认证相关日志..."
openclaw logs --follow | grep -i "auth\|token\|unauthorized" | tail -10
description: 验证 Control UI 认证配置和设备配对状态，包括 Gateway Token、Gateway 运行状态、设备列表和认证日志
expected_output: Gateway Token 配置、运行状态、设备列表、认证日志
